The great medicine master, Bo Hla Aung, arrived in the village of Ywar Thayar while traveling. He asked permission from the Sayadaw and stayed overnight at the monastery. When morning broke, children from the village arrived at the monastery. They cleaned up and offered flowers to the Buddha. The medicine master watched the children in amazement.

"Do you always come to the monastery and perform meritorious deeds like this?" "Yes, Grandpa. There is Dhamma School at the monastery every Sunday. Every Dhamma School day, we perform meritorious deeds like this. We learn how to perform meritorious deeds. We also recite poems. We listen to stories and tales too... Grandpa."

At that moment, a bell rang. The children entered the classroom. The medicine master was delighted and joyful watching the well-behaved and polite Dhamma School students.
